title: The Path to Elminster
summary: Supplies the door sequence to open the Elminster Vault.

fields.Puzzle: In the Sorcerous Vault, take Silverhand, then Evocation, then Wish. Pull the lever to unlock the Elminster Vault, then return to the entrance. Knock can open the vault directly.
fields.Acquisition: Under Tolna’s counter at X 10, Y −92.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
